---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or a GitKraken/GitLens feature to clone
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is this already on the roadmap?**
Check [ROADMAP.md](../../docs/ROADMAP.md) first. If it's already planned, comment on this issue with any extra context instead of duplicating it.

**What's the feature?**
A clear description of what you want to happen, and what problem it solves.

**How does GitKraken/GitLens do this today (if applicable)?**
If this clones an existing GitKraken/GitLens feature, describe the behavior you're referencing.

**Proposed approach (optional)**
If you have thoughts on implementation (which git plumbing it needs, whether it needs a backend, etc.), share them here.

**Additional context**
Anything else relevant.
